purpose: Generate a structured citizen-facing case report from an approved investigation without exposing restricted evidence or internal system reasoning.
core_principle: APPROVED SNAPSHOT → PRIVACY FILTER → STRUCTURED REPORT → OFFICIAL SOURCES → NEXT ACTIONS
rules: Only approved snapshots may be exported as definitive reports.
The report must reflect the snapshot version and verification state.
Public report content must pass the privacy/publication boundary.
Official sources must be rendered through the citation resolver.
A report is a representation of the approved answer, not a new legal determination.
Historical reports retain their historical scope and predecessor/version references.
hard_stops: Never export an unreviewed case as a verified report.
Never expose restricted evidence merely because it exists in the case file.
Never invent a deadline, remedy, authority or source.
Never alter the underlying immutable answer snapshot during export.
